notes:
内核跟上上游稳定版，DNS 决策收进一处。

- **内核对齐 mihomo v1.19.31。** 带入的上游修复里与我们相关的是：hysteria2 连接关闭时逐个
  释放 UDP 会话；DomainSet 通配符与更长规则重叠时不再漏匹配；握手失败后及时关闭套接字、
  VLESS 初始化失败仍持有清理句柄、DoQ 错误路径释放 UDP 套接字。这三组此前由我们自己回补，
  这次退役给上游。YueLink 自有的 17 个运行时补丁（同步关停、全部监听器释放、MMDB 零值守卫、
  gVisor 缓冲放宽、recvmsg_x 降级闩等）一条不少地带过去，fork 现为 v1.19.31 之上 25 个提交、
  0 落后。REALITY 客户端握手行为不变：utls 版本未动，上游新增的只是订阅链接里
  `support-x25519mlkem768` 参数的解析。
- **DNS 决策收进一个对象。** `respect-rules` / `prefer-h3` 的强制写入、fake-ip 范围与「这个
  地址是不是 fake-ip」的判定、fake-ip 过滤名单的两份手抄、顶层 `ipv6` 的三处同款写法，此前散在
  六个文件里；现在由 `DnsPolicy` 一处决定，其余只消费。这是**结构收敛而不是行为改动**：
  拆前先对七组订阅模板 × 桌面 TUN / 移动 tunFd / IPv6 开关 / fake-ip 各分支渲染出 15 份黄金
  样本，拆后逐字节相同；把任一决策值翻掉，黄金样本立刻变红。计划中的行为改动
  （`respect-rules` 回退、删 `fallback` 块）仍门控在真机掉线网络验证之后，本版不含。
- 内部：依赖前滚——file_picker 13、cached_network_image 4 与六个补丁版本；Flutter 3.47.4 /
  Dart 约束不变。tray_manager 0.7 与 very_good_analysis 11 因抬高 Dart 下限且前者是整套 API
  搬家，本轮不取。
- 日常使用没有可见变化。
notesEn:
Core caught up with upstream stable; DNS decisions now live in one place.

- **Core aligned with mihomo v1.19.31.** Of the upstream fixes it brings, the ones that touch us:
  hysteria2 closes every UDP session when the QUIC connection closes; DomainSet no longer misses
  a wildcard match shadowed by a longer overlapping rule; sockets are closed after a failed
  handshake, VLESS keeps its cleanup handle when initialisation fails, and DoQ releases its UDP
  socket on the error path. All three had been back-ported by us and are now retired to upstream.
  YueLink's own 17 runtime patches (synchronous shutdown, release of every listener, MMDB
  zero-value guards, the gVisor buffer widening, the recvmsg_x downgrade latch, …) carried over
  intact; the fork is now 25 commits ahead of v1.19.31, 0 behind. The REALITY client handshake is
  unchanged: utls did not move, and upstream's only addition is parsing the
  `support-x25519mlkem768` share-link parameter.
- **DNS decisions converged into one object.** The forced `respect-rules` / `prefer-h3` pair, the
  fake-ip range and the "is this address a fake-ip" judgement, two hand-typed copies of the
  fake-ip filter list, and three identical writers of the top-level `ipv6` flag were spread across
  six files; `DnsPolicy` now decides once and every former site only consumes. This is a
  **structural** change, not a behavioural one: 15 golden renders (seven subscription shapes ×
  desktop TUN / mobile tunFd / IPv6 on-off / fake-ip branches) were captured before the move and
  are byte-identical after it, and flipping any single policy value turns them red. The planned
  behaviour changes (reverting `respect-rules`, dropping the `fallback` block) remain gated on
  real-device drop-out testing and are not in this release.
- Internal: dependency roll-forward — file_picker 13, cached_network_image 4 and six patch
  bumps; Flutter 3.47.4 / Dart constraints unchanged. tray_manager 0.7 and very_good_analysis 11
  were left out: both raise the Dart floor, and the former is a whole-API migration.
- Nothing changes in day-to-day use.
